title: envelope
description: Wrapper carried by every event regardless of kind. The envelope is how the substrate navigates the log without understanding any payload. `v` versions the envelope; `kind_v` versions the payload. The two change independently.

v.description: Envelope version. The one field whose name and position never change: readers check it first, and refuse a version they do not know rather than guess. Bump only for a breaking envelope change; adding an optional envelope field does not bump.

id.description: ULID. The event's identity. Never reuse. Not the cursor: concurrent writers can commit ULIDs out of order, so the store's commit sequence is the cursor.

ts.description: RFC3339 UTC, millisecond precision. Redundant with the ULID prefix but kept because humans and SQL both want a real timestamp.

kind.description: Event type, e.g. 'candidate.measured'. Everything dispatches on this string. Declared kinds (program.committed, candidate.measured, budget.spent) are validated on write; all others are free.

kind_v.description: Payload version for THIS kind only, independent of `v` and of every other kind. Resolve against schema/<kind>/v<kind_v>.json to interpret the payload. Readers that encounter an unknown version should refuse rather than guess.

subject.description: What this event is ABOUT (not who wrote it — that is `actor`), as 'type:rest'. Known types: prog:sha256:<hex>, bench:<name>, pool:<name>, dir:<ulid>, hyp:<ulid>. New types may be added freely; the 'type:rest' shape is the contract. history(subject) retrieves everything about one thing, across all actors: a program typically accumulates a commit from a lab assistant, several measurements from the verifier, and notes from the researcher, all under one subject.

actor.description: Provenance: who produced this event. Required as a key, but its CONTENTS are free — add fields whenever a new loop architecture needs them. This is what later answers 'did Opus-authored programs outperform Qwen mutations, per token spent?'

role.description: Free string naming the position in whatever architecture is current, e.g. 'researcher', 'lab_assistant', 'verifier', 'human'. Deliberately not an enum: a future loop that isn't researcher/assistant shaped must not require a schema change.

model.description: Model identifier, or absent for pure-code actors. e.g. 'claude-opus-5', 'qwen3.8-flash-next-fp4'.

harness.description: Which loop generation wrote this, ideally path@git-sha, e.g. 'loops/v1@a3f9c21'. Lets you segment results by the code that produced them after a rewrite.

idem.description: Optional idempotency key. append() with an idem already present returns the existing event id without writing. Set it on any event a crashed job might retry, so a retry cannot double-count a measurement or a budget charge.

payload.description: Kind-specific body. Validated on write for declared kinds; passed through untouched for free kinds.
